# Generators

Continuous-output generators: each maps a conditioning hidden state to a sampled latent vector rather than a distribution over classes. All share one sample/forward surface; the CALM encoder picks one by the ``generator_type`` baked into its profile.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("generators")``, declared in ``praxis.generators`` (3 entries)

## `energy` - EnergyGenerator

Conditioned implicit generator of continuous latents.

``hidden_dim`` is the residual width carrying the noise/cond stream through the blocks;
``cond_dim`` / ``noise_dim`` are the input widths (typically the LM hidden state width
and the noise vector width respectively).

Source: [praxis/generators/energy.py:325](../praxis/generators/energy.py#L325)

## `flow` - FlowGenerator

Flow-matching latent generator. Sibling of ``EnergyGenerator``.

Same constructor kwargs as ``EnergyGenerator`` for registry interchange; ``noise_dim``
is ignored (the flow starts in latent space) and is reported as ``latent_dim`` so
callers size their start state correctly.

Source: [praxis/generators/flow.py:146](../praxis/generators/flow.py#L146)

## `harmonic` - HarmonicLatentGenerator

Flow-matching latent generator over a harmonic coefficient space.

Same constructor kwargs as ``FlowGenerator``/``EnergyGenerator`` for registry
interchange. ``noise_dim`` is reported as ``latent_dim`` (the caller builds a latent-
width start state, projected internally), matching ``FlowGenerator``.

Source: [praxis/generators/harmonic_latent.py:59](../praxis/generators/harmonic_latent.py#L59)
